<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex027102026-11-1111-44-20" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:dgos_brel"> brjod bya ni | <expan>bstan bcos</expan> lus kyi dgos 'brel 4 lta bu'o || 
               de'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> | dgos 'brel ngag gis stan la dbab par bya ba'i chos so | 
               dgos pa ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5552">braM ze bde byed dga' ba</rs> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5830">bud+ha shis</rs> dgos 'brel ngag 'di bkod pas gzhung gi yige mdzes par byas pa lta bu 'di'i dgos par bzhed ¦ 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo ts+tsha ba <expan>chen po</expan></rs> | dgos 'brel ngag 'di bkod pas
            <pb n="15"/>
               <lb edRef="inst:4658" n="8a1"/> gzhung mdzes ba bskyed pa la der bzhed | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5535">dul ba lha</rs> ni : dgos 'grol ngag 'di bkod pa la <expan>rten nas</expan> <expan>bstan bcos</expan> nyan pa po spro° ba bskyed pa der bzhed || 
              <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dz+nya na shri</rs> ¦ dgos 'brel ngag 'di bkod pa la <expan>rten nas</expan> <expan>bstan bcos</expan> 'di dgos pa yod pa nges shes skyes pa der bzhed || 
              <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">chos mchog</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">seng bzangs</rs> | dgos 'brel ngag 'di bkod pa la <expan>rten nas</expan> <expan>bstan bcos</expan> la dgos swo yod snyaM du
               <lb edRef="inst:4658" n="8a2"/>don 'gyur the tshoM skyes pa der <expan>bshed do</expan> | </seg></TEI>
